measurements.innerText:
TradePulse Pay
RESIDENTIAL REMODEL GCS · PAYPAL SANDBOX

PAY APPS FOR OWNER-RUN REMODELS

Pay the right amount.
Keep the receipt.
Choose your seat

Start with the GC seat. No signup or sponsor account is needed for the core demo. These buttons use ordinary demo-account sign-in, not an authentication bypass.

General contractor
→
Review a sub's pay app and release sandbox payment.
gc@demo.tradepulse
Subcontractor
→
Sign in as Ortiz Plumbing on the settled Lopez Kitchen Remodel pay app.
sub4@demo.tradepulse
Project owner
→
See job progress and pay a change-order invoice.
owner@demo.tradepulse
Normal sign-in / create a GC account

This public build uses PayPal sandbox money only. No real funds move, and every demo account is shared.

Manual sign-in and sandbox details
Catch overbilling early

Every line is checked against the schedule of values, exclusions and what was already paid.

Decide with the evidence

See the contract, change orders, licence status and prior payments beside the amount you are approving.

Keep a clean owner trail

Sub pay apps, owner invoices and PayPal receipts stay tied to one job ledger for the owner or lender.

Built for the GC running a handful of kitchens, additions and whole-home remodels — not a billion-dollar ERP. Rules compute the money. A model can explain the evidence. You make the call.

Judge walkthrough: inspect a settled run or create a new one
+
Sandbox payment

Funding and invoice payment still require real sandbox browser approval. This is not a claim of full-contract completion.

What to verify

Read the rules-computed amounts and the model’s explanations in the approval inbox. Check PayPal captures are COMPLETED, payout items are SUCCESS, and the Owner invoice is PAID. Dashboard and agreement-ledger totals must agree. Pending, unclaimed or failed is not paid.

Honest limits

Model or browser-service failures are surfaced, not presented as successful live calls. Compliance documents, sub submissions and Owner change-order approval are explicitly labeled as examples.

Canonical: tradepulse-pay.asynchronope.tech/#/demo
